insurance_business_line.label: Insurance business line
insurance_business_line.value: Annuities and life insurance, including pension risk transfer group annuities.

premium_exposure_mix.label: Premium / exposure mix
premium_exposure_mix.value: Individual annuities, pension risk transfer group annuities, and individual life insurance.

reinsurance_catastrophe_protection.label: Reinsurance / catastrophe protection
reinsurance_catastrophe_protection.value: Quota-share reinsurance cessions on annuity business.

liability_duration_guarantees_life_and_a.label: Liability duration / guarantees [life and annuity]
liability_duration_guarantees_life_and_a.value: Fixed indexed annuities with downside protection, group annuities backing transferred pension benefits, and life insurance protection.

investment_liability_matching.label: Investment / liability matching
investment_liability_matching.value: Fixed-income assets aligned with liability cash flows and equity index options hedging indexed annuity credits.
